delivery.en: Collect at the post office or arrange a courier drop; no detailed official doorstep guide was found
delivery.zh: 可到郵局領或請快遞約定投放；官方上門投遞細則此次沒找到

readback.en: Area code 268, then 3-3-4; 0 as zero; East Caribbean dollars; 12-hour time; day before month
readback.zh: 區碼 268 再唸 3-3-4，0 唸 zero；東加勒比元；12 時制；先日後月

fraud.en: A caller pretending to be from Flow, Digicel or APUA, or asking details for a prize, is a scam
fraud.zh: 來電假冒 Flow、Digicel 或 APUA，或為了領獎向你要資料，都是詐騙

habits.en: With strangers, start Good afternoon and say mobile, not cell. Amounts are in East Caribbean dollars. Day first.
habits.zh: 對生人先說 Good afternoon，並說 mobile 不說 cell。金額用東加勒比元。日期先日後月。

stall_local.en: The Flow or Digicel app wants a new password, and I cannot reach the post office before closing.
stall_local.zh: Flow 或 Digicel App 要設新密碼，而且在關門前趕不到郵局。

reason.zh: 美國轉帳工具，不是安地卡電信或銀行的慣用說法
美國稅局；本地警示主寫假冒電信人員
美式用語，當地較常說 mobile

talk_style_diff.en: Polite and a little formal with unknown callers. Use APUA, Flow or Digicel names only to refuse impostors, and East Caribbean dollars, not US tax language.
talk_style_diff.zh: 對陌生來電客氣、稍正式。提到 APUA、Flow、Digicel 是為了識破假冒，金額用東加勒比元，不用美國稅務詞。

uncertain: 安地卡郵政的上門投遞規則此次沒找到官方細頁，delivery 只寫郵局或快遞。
habits 裡 Good afternoon 是英式加勒比習慣，不是通話錄音統計。
